BILL NO. 6-16-26-2
ORDINANCE NO. 5388
(of Clark County, Nevada)
AN ORDINANCE AUTHORIZING THE ISSUANCE BY THE
COUNTY OF ITS CLARK COUNTY, NEVADA, GENERAL
OBLIGATION (LIMITED TAX) BOND BANK REFUNDING
BONDS (ADDITIONALLY SECURED BY SNWA PLEDGED
REVENUES), SERIES 2026, IN THE MAXIMUM PRINCIPAL
AMOUNT OF $177,140,000 FOR THE PURPOSE OF
REFUNDING SECURITIES ISSUED BY THE COUNTY ON
BEHALF OF THE SOUTHERN NEVADA WATER
AUTHORITY; PROVIDING THE FORM, TERMS AND
CONDITIONS OF THE BONDS AND OTHER DETAILS IN
CONNECTION THEREWITH; PROVIDING OTHER
MATTERS RELATING THERETO.
PUBLIC NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that typewritten copies of the above
numbered and entitled ordinance are available for inspection by all interested parties at the office
of the County Clerk of Clark County, Nevada, at the office of the County Clerk in the Clark County
Government Center, Las Vegas, Nevada; and that such ordinance was proposed by Commissioner
Michael Naft on June 16, 2026, and was passed at a meeting held on June 16, 2026, by the
following vote of the Board of County Commissioners:
Those Voting Aye: Michael Naft _____________
William McCurdy II _______
April Becker _____________
James B, Gibson __________
Tustin Tones ______________
Marilyn K, Kirkpatrick _____
Tick Segerblom
Those Voting Nay: None
Those Absent: None
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Board of County Commissioners of Clark County,
Nevada, has caused this ordinance to be published twice by title only.
DATED on June 16, 2026.

ORDINANCE NO. 5388
(of Clark County, Nevada)
AN ORDINANCE AUTHORIZING
THE ISSUANCE BY THE COUNTY
OF ITS CLARK COUNTY, NEVADA,
GENERAL OBLIGATION (LIMITED
TAX) BOND BANK
REFUNDING BONDS
(ADDmONALLY SECURED BY
SNWA PLEDGED REVENUES),
SERIES 2026, IN THE MAXIMUM
PRINCIPAL AMOUNT OF
$177,140,000 FOR THE PURPOSE
OF REFUNDING SECURITIES
ISSUED BY THE COUNTY
ON BEHALF OF THE SOUTHERN
NEVADA WATER AUTHORITY;
PROVIDING THE FORM, TERMS
AND CONDITIONS OF THE
BONDS AND OTHER DETAILS
IN CONNECTION THEREWITH;
PROVIDING OTHER MATTERS
RELATING THERETO.
PUBLIC NOTICE IS HEREBY
GIVEN that typewritten copies
of the above numbered and
entitled ordinance are available
for inspection by all interested
parties at the office of the
County Clerk of Clark County,
Nevada, at the office of the
County Clerk in the Clark
CountyGovernment Center, Las 
Vegas, Nevada; and that such
ordinance was proposed by
Commissioner Michael Naft on
June 16, 2026, and was passed
at a meeting held on June 16,
2026, by the following vote of
the Board of County
Commissioners:
Those Voting Aye:
Michael Naft
William McCurdy II
April Becker
James B. Gibson
Justin Jones
Marilyn K. Kirkpatrick
Tick Segerblom
Those Voting Nay; None
Those Absent: None
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the
Board of County
Commissioners of Clark
County, Nevada, has caused
this ordinance to be published
twice by title only.
DATED on June 16,2026.
/s/ Michael Naft
Chair
Board of County
Commissioners
Clark County, Nevada
Attest:
/s/ Lynn Marie Goya
County Clerk
PUB: June 23,30,2026
LV Review-Journal
